role: possible pragmatic interpretation
notes: A assigns actuality sets; F assigns individual/predicate intensions; R assigns arbitrary operator relations.

role: index set actuality sets and union of possible individuals
notes: Source DA is domain of A; quantifiers range over U not only A_i; empty U is permitted but contributes no countermodels to sentence consequence.

role: logical actuality predicate
notes: E[zeta] tests membership of the denoted possible individual in A_i; not the modern congruential modal system E.

role: relation between an index and a proposition truth set
notes: Subset of I times power set of I; no closure conditions are imposed by a possible interpretation.

role: empty tuple and zero-place relation truth values
notes: Lambda is the empty sequence/set; false is Lambda and true is its singleton; Roman F is distinct from the interpretation function F.

role: indexed extension of a term or formula
notes: Terms give functions on the appropriate assignment set; formulas give its subsets.

role: index-to-extension intension
notes: At each index returns Ext; no separate hierarchy of indirect intensions is introduced.

role: replacement of an ordinary assignment coordinate
scope: P8 Montague Synthese 1970 ordinary and extended pragmatics
notes: The source uses function-replacement subscripts/superscripts; replacement is explicit here.

role: k-place predicate variable numbered n
notes: k is a nonnegative arity; variables denote predicate intensions rather than index-local relations.

role: predicate-constant argument type sequence
notes: Minus one is an individual argument; k at least zero is a predicate-intension argument of arity k; type <0> is unary over propositions.

role: unique predicate description with empty default
notes: Binds predicate variable G in phi; no individual description is admitted; Roman truth value T is a different role.

role: full predicate-intension and typed variable domains
notes: P_k consists of all functions I to power set of U^k; D_minus-one=U; these are not arbitrary Henkin subdomains.

role: all typed assignment systems and their coordinates
notes: Coordinate (n,-1) is individual v_n; coordinate (n,k) is predicate G_(n,k) for nonnegative k.

role: typed coordinate replacement
notes: Y belongs to the correct typed coordinate domain.

role: term extension evaluated on a typed assignment
notes: Abbreviates Ext_(i,A)(xi)(x); a predicate term still denotes the whole I-indexed intension.

role: empty predicate intension of arity k
notes: Value is empty relation at every index; graph is I times singleton of empty set; default for failed description uniqueness.

role: source predicate/property/proposition names
notes: Descriptions uniquely defining the formula's full indexed predicate; empty variable list gives the proposition that phi.

role: predicate of propositions corresponding to a pragmatic operator
notes: Type <0>; its local extension accepts exactly the propositions whose truth sets are related by R_N to the current index.

role: empirical belief and seeming predicate constants
notes: Types <-1,0> and <-1,1,-1>; no logical psychological axioms imposed.

role: extended operator degree and bound-variable operand predicate
notes: m bound individual variables; n individual arguments; p formula arguments generating m-place intensions under fixed remaining assignment.

role: modern neighborhood family obtained as a section of R_N
notes: J belongs iff (i,J) belongs to R_N; modern closure systems are not attributed as Montague's axiomatizations.

role: eliminable equality and emptiness formulas for predicate intensions
notes: Defined by universal-index agreement on all individual tuples; k=0 has no individual quantifiers.

role: description-elimination abbreviations
notes: Explicitly defined formulas selecting unique satisfying predicate or the empty default; not new semantic primitives.
